card.name: Broken dashes and titles before names
card.fires_on: Pieces of garbled or split text: the 'ash' ending a broken en dash (–) between birth and death years, a mangled apostrophe, and Mr/Ms/Mrs before a surname in news text.

modes.label: Dash between life dates
modes.description: The 'ash' in a broken – between years in painter biographies.

modes.label: Courtesy titles
modes.description: Mr, Ms or Mrs right before a surname.

modes.description: A garbled character or a mid-word piece in a name or drug name.
